title: Phone Ko Kaise Pata Chalta Hai Upar Kahan Hai? 🤔 #shorts
description:
Aapke phone ke andar ek chhota sa silicon mass hai jo lagbhag 20,000 baar per second vibrate karta hai, aur wahi rotation feel karta hai.
🔬 MEMS gyroscope ke andar vibrating proof mass kaise kaam karta hai
🌀 Coriolis force mass ko side mein kaise dhakelta hai
⚡ Comb capacitors nanometer se bhi chhota movement kaise pakadte hain
📐 Rotation speed se angle kaise banta hai, aur drift kyun aata hai
🧭 Accelerometer gravity se drift kaise theek karta hai

Aapka phone ghoomna kaise feel karta hai? 🤯

Chip ke andar ek tiny silicon mass har second hazaron baar vibrate kar raha hai. Poora mechanism dekho 👇

🔬 Gyro angle nahi, rotation ki speed (degree per second) naapta hai
🌀 Coriolis force vibrating mass ko side mein dhakelta hai
⚡ Comb jaisi plates nanometer se bhi chhota khiskaav pakad leti hain
🧭 Gyro drift karta hai, isliye accelerometer gravity se use theek karta hai
